verdicts.reason: A squeezes the whole original layout into the top half and leaves roughly 45% of the canvas as dead lavender above a stranded legal line, so it reads like a shrunk copy, not a rearrangement; the can is also jammed against the headline column. B restacks the design properly for the tall format (headline, subhead, CTA, product, legal) and fills the canvas, but the circle now sits behind 'WEEKEND ONLY' and '20% off' instead of the product, the legal line is set nearly as large as the subhead, and the bottom footer and the product spacing are a little uneven.
